topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the lecture framework, objectives, and upcoming concepts in cancer evolution.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how somatic mutations and epigenetic alterations drive clonal succession and Darwinian selection in tumor development.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies and the cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the relationship between normal tissue hierarchies, cancer stem cells, and the cell of origin using leukemia and intestinal models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate how chronic inflammation, environmental promoters, and supportive stromal cells facilitate tumor emergence and maintenance.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It details the laboratory and analytical approaches, including single-cell sequencing and spatial omics, used to investigate tumor dynamics.

topics.label: Integrative evolutionary model of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes how mutational, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors converge to drive malignant progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of the next session
topics.groupedBecause: It closes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
